title: Ovarian tissue wedge call packet
executiveSummary: ovarian-tissue is currently anchored on slow-freezing protocols built around Dimethyl Sulfoxide, Sucrose, Ethylene Glycol, with a normalized workflow backbone of cooling -> warming.
The atlas is credible enough to use for wedge-finding: reviewed gates pass, reviewed outcome coverage is 0.429, and reviewed step-phase coverage is 0.571.

The explicit active wedge is "Head-to-head DMSO-centered ovarian tissue benchmark", selected because it gives the clearest decision question and the most reviewable next experiment under the current evidence.

standardOfCareView.summary: Current default literature center of gravity is slow-freezing, usually built around Dimethyl Sulfoxide, Sucrose, Ethylene Glycol in follicles, ovarian tissue workflows. Normalized workflow signal is cooling -> warming, with repeated condition mentions such as Dimethyl Sulfoxide 1.5 M.
